description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a Downloads screen in a Kindle clone app. It manages download requests, displays download progress, and interacts with external services and providers.

classes.name: DownloadsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of ongoing or completed book downloads and allows starting new downloads.

classes.name: _DownloadsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and logic for the DownloadsScreen, including initiating downloads, polling status, and updating UI.

methods.name: _startDownload
methods.description: Initiates a download request based on user input, manages the download polling, and updates the UI with progress and status.
